No other socket in 1,681 lsof samples, children included.
no_network_request.likely_cause_from_source: editor/app/src/provider.rs: the restore action returns public_state(true), which calls auth::access_token; crates/incant_agent/src/auth.rs access_token_inner renews the saved session when the access token expires within 60 s (POST https://auth.openai.com/api/accounts/oauth/token, then GET openid-configuration and JWKS to validate the new ID token). These files are unchanged between the 0048 build (bb1b517) and this one, so 0048's quiet reopen five minutes after its turn and this exchange about 41 minutes later fit a time-dependent renewal. Not verified: the saved token's expiry was not read, and the host name was not observed.

The first redacted copies were converted to sRGB by imgtool, changing every pixel value slightly; imgtool now keeps the captures' Display P3 values, and the committed images were regenerated from the raw captures (imgtool diff confirms only the avatar box changed). No capture was retaken.
limitations: macOS on this display only; two window sizes and two column widths; the default model value and the default approval mode only. A longer model value was not checked.
Focus was read every 0.2-0.4 s; a focus change shorter than that would not be seen.
Network observations are samples of this run: nettop covered only the editor PID, lsof sampled every 0.5 s, WebKit processes were not watched, and the remote host name was not observed.
